requirement: The floating Need help? pill stays in the conversation column's corner when opening or closing the left column moves that column

oracle.ref: PR #924 (fix); fix evidence: Acceptance of #922 on cowork.tracy.site 05/10/2026: with the side card open, GAP was 16 with the left column as a rail and 240 when wide; the column was 760px wide both ways, so ResizeObserver never fired.
oracle.invariant: The column width is the same before and after each toggle (the column moves, it does not resize) — this is the condition the bug needs; if the width changes, note it, the case still checks GAP. GAP is 16 (+/-2) in S3 and after both toggles in S4. Before the fix it was 240 with the left column wide (dev at 301d49b6c, 05/10/2026).
